# Empty and check the bin

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba 600 and 700 series · Roomba 800 and 900 series

![Empty and check the bin](../img/bin_600_900--bin.svg)

**What it does**

The bin holds what the robot picks up. A full or badly seated bin stops it from picking up more.

**How to**

1. Press the bin release and take the bin out.
2. Open the bin door over a waste bin and empty it.
3. Take the filter out, tap it clean and remove dust from the filter seat.
4. Put the filter back and slide the bin in until it clicks.

> **Note** Rinse only a bin made for it, with the filter taken out, and let it dry completely before it goes back.

## Roomba e, i and j series, Combo j

![Empty and check the bin](../img/bin_eij--bin.svg)

**What it does**

The bin holds what the robot picks up. A full or badly seated bin stops it from picking up more.

**How to**

1. Press the bin release on the back of the robot and take the bin out.
2. Open the bin door over a waste bin and empty the bin.
3. Take the filter out and tap it clean. Rinse the bin by hand with warm water if it is dirty.
4. Let the bin dry completely, put the filter back and slide the bin in until it clicks.

> **Note** Rinse by hand only, never in a dishwasher, and never with the filter in it.

## Roomba s series

![Empty and check the bin](../img/bin_s--bin.svg)

**What it does**

The bin holds what the robot picks up. A full or badly seated bin stops it from picking up more.

**How to**

1. Press the release on the lid and lift the bin out by its handle.
2. Hold the bin over a waste bin and press its release to empty it.
3. Take the filter out and tap it clean. Rinse the bin with warm water if it is dirty.
4. Let the bin dry completely, put the filter back and the bin into the robot.

> **Note** Rinse by hand only, never in a dishwasher, and never with the filter in it.
